core.title: Mesa Knob With Square Rose, Weslock 007054

text.description_html:
Weslock 007054, Mesa Knob with Square Rose

The Mesa contemporary door knob features a square rose and round knob. This door knob is not only contemporary but its unique shape is ultra sleek making it an excellent choice for those who like a more minimalistic look. Available in your choice of black or satin nickel finishes. The Mesa Knob with square Rose is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches with a removable faceplate.

This contemporary Knobset is from the Weslock Transitional Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Mesa Knob with Square Rose:

  • Rose and lever material: Zinc Diecast
  • Adjustable latches include removable faceplates.
  • Removable door lever prevents scratching during installation.
  • Panic-proof privacy function - one turn of interior lever unlocks and opens door.
  • Push-button locking rosette.
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Weslock Mesa Knob With Square Rose:

  • Knob Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Rose Length: 2-1/2" square
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate
  • Fits doors prepared with 2-1/8" cross hole and 1" edge hole

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim. Does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock. Door lever operates latch from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking for privacy. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy lock; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy and retract latchbolt.

Sold Individually
